subject: compiling httpuv  with R 3.0.1 on Solaris 10

messages.author: 03260d6b59ce9a07
messages.subject: compiling httpuv  with R 3.0.1 on Solaris 10
parts:
Hello

My colleagues asked me to install “R” with module “shiny”. R version 3.0.1 compiled fine on Solaris 10 and is running well.

I tried to install “shiny”. With the dependencies “httpuv” should be installed before. But the compile step did fail. See below.

The initial error message is “Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :”

I am absolutely not familiar with R but I  could manage to compile a lot of source code on Solaris. Very often it’s only a small change in Makefile or source code. In this case I am a little bit lost, as I cannot find any reference to "sendfile64". I hope for your support.


Kind regards

Hans
